description: Finds the React Native / Expo component for a mobile app's need in plain words, such as a button, a tab bar or a bottom sheet: Liquid Glass on iOS 26, Material 3 Expressive on Android. Ranked, and says when this catalog ships nothing on purpose because the phone's own control is the right choice. Omit `need` to list every component and its purpose.

need.description: e.g. "a progress bar for an upload"

name: find_component
title: Find a component
